name: arrowWrite
note: mov [rcx+88],edx (89 91 88 00 00 00) writes the arrow count; NOP 6 = arrows never change. Wildcards over the patched bytes.

name: devBool
note: Developer booleans (game's own dev cheats): +0 Focus, +1 Might, +2 Elf Shot, +3 Wrath. From SeiKur0 CT v21C; verified 2026-11-11 (HUD meters full).

name: missionTimer
note: +0xF: 84 C0 -> EB 06 = timed missions never fail on time. Wildcards over the patched bytes.

name: multiSkill
note: je -> jmp (74 3B -> EB 3B) at AcquireAbility exe+0x1BC8DEF: activating an upgrade no longer revokes the siblings' items. Wildcards over the patched byte so it resolves when already patched.

name: mightNoDrain
note: Might setter exe+0x44FCD0: minss xmm6,[rcx+0x3A8] -> movss (F3 0F 5D -> F3 0F 10 at exe+0x44FD16). Every Might write becomes max, old==new so the setter skips its update: no drain, no refill, no 'Might full' growl. With Infinite Might (devBool+1) the dev branch exe+0x44F520 refilled to max each tick after a spend = the growl. Wildcard over the patched byte.

name: lootPick
note: Captain gear drop pick: call exe+0x579F90(&tmp, picker, 0) at exe+0x6483FC returns a Faction/Loot/NemesisGear record (SeiKur0 CT 'Epic/Legendary Uruks drop specific item'). Points at the E8; the rel32 is redirected by the Loot tab.

name: canPurchaseSkill
note: CanPurchaseSkill entry (exe+0x1BC9830). From the user's CT 'Unlock All Skills' (Reverser 2024): +0xA4 je 0F 84 2A 01 00 00 (story/setup lock) -> NOP 6, +0xEB jae 73 (min level) -> EB, +0x12F je 74 (requires N of X) -> EB.

name: healthWrite
note: Damage write: comiss xmm6,xmm2 ; movss [rbx+42C],xmm2 (exe+0x2E4D26). From the user's SeiKur0 CT 'Unlimited Health'. Hooked by SOW.HEALTH_LOCK.

From the user's SeiKur0 CT 'Complete all item challenges'. Patched bytes wildcarded.
